blind.description: A polished golden chalice or ceremonial goblet. It features a wide, rounded hemispherical bowl at the top, a decorative stem node (knop) adorned with small red circular gemstones or inlaid jewels, and an eight-pointed scalloped flower-like base. The surface is clean, solid, and continuous with no floating, melted, or broken parts. It rests directly on its ornamental base flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A circular golden opening looking down into the concave interior of the bowl towards a central point, casting an oval shadow to the upper-left, with the scalloped petals of the base largely occluded by the rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-sixth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 10 to 12 inches tall) and about 7 to 8 inches in diameter.
